lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular blobs is visible in the mid-flank region posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows with a varying inter-centroid distance of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observable intersecting with the horizontal spot rows, creating a faint grid-like structure particularly evident in the transition zone between the fifth gill slit and the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges (carinae) are visible running horizontally across the upper flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance values along the dorsal edge of each ridge and deep-shadow low-luminance values along the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A partial view of the left pectoral fin is present in the lower-left quadrant, exhibiting a pattern of high-luminance blobs that are smaller and more densely packed toward the posterior margin of the fin edge.
